title: Nutrition
intro: Training-focused fueling and hydration guidance. Detailed food logs, bodyweight, calorie totals and private health information are intentionally excluded from the public dashboard.

sections.heading: Current focus
items: Support the upcoming race-practice long run with adequate carbohydrate intake.
Keep daily protein intake consistent across running and strength days.
Prioritise hydration and sleep alongside food intake during higher-volume weeks.

sections.heading: Before key sessions
items: Eat a carbohydrate-focused meal in the hours before long or quality sessions.
Avoid beginning a long run under-fuelled simply because the early kilometres feel easy.
Use familiar foods before important sessions rather than experimenting on the day.

sections.heading: During long runs
items: Begin taking carbohydrates early rather than waiting until fatigue appears.
Use a consistent gel or carbohydrate schedule throughout the session.
Take fluids according to conditions and practise the same approach intended for race day.

sections.heading: After training
items: Combine protein with carbohydrates after demanding sessions.
Replace fluids and include sodium when training conditions or sweat losses warrant it.
Treat recovery nutrition as preparation for the next session, not only a reward for the completed one.

sections.heading: Current status
items: Carbohydrate priority: increase around long and quality sessions.
Hydration priority: arrive at key sessions well hydrated and replace fluids afterward.

sections.heading: Privacy boundary
items: No bodyweight, calorie targets or meal-by-meal records are published here.
Detailed nutrition discussions remain in the private coaching conversation and repository notes.
Only general training guidance suitable for the public dashboard is displayed.
